summary: Backend-only regression + focused unit testing for the 3-part bugfix in ebms-orchestrator (INBOUND messages incorrectly retried on OUTBOUND queue; retry AMQP message missing reconstructed EbxmlMessageHeader; watchdog using a single 5-min threshold for both directions). Wrote new /app/ebms-adapter/ebms-orchestrator/src/test/java/nl/logius/ebms/orchestrator/service/OrchestratorServiceRetryHeaderTest.java (4 tests) - a pure @Mock RabbitTemplate test capturing convertAndSend() args to assert the reconstructed header content (cpaId, conversationId, from/to PartyId+type, service/serviceType, action, MessageInfo, ackRequested->AckRequested-or-null) and entity state transitions (retryCount++, status=PROCESSING, lastRetryAt set). Re-ran the rewritten MessageStatusReconciliationSchedulerTest (3/3 pass: outbound threshold~now-5min, inbound threshold~now-30min with 'downstream-consument' hint, empty=noop). Full ebms-orchestrator test suite: 31 tests, 0 failures, 3 Docker-env errors (Testcontainers-based InboundPipelineIntegrationTest / OutboundPipelineIntegrationTest / OrchestratorServiceIntegrationTest cannot start - pre-existing 'no Docker in preview container' limitation, unchanged from iteration_19). All 28 non-Docker unit tests pass. `mvn compile` and `mvn test-compile` clean under JDK 21.0.2 + Maven 3.9.6.

minor.issue: Cannot start - 'Could not find a valid Docker environment'. Pre-existing sandbox limitation (no Docker socket), not a code defect. Consistent with iteration_15/19 findings. The 2 new Testcontainers regression tests (retryFailedMessages_inboundDirection_isNeverRetried, findMessagesForRetry_inboundDirection_isNeverCandidate) added by the main agent cannot be executed here for the same reason - noted as a known restriction; they compile cleanly.

critical_code_review_comments: Fix #1 (EbmsMessageRepository.findMessagesForRetry): JPQL correctly narrowed with `AND m.direction = 'OUTBOUND'`. Uses string literal (enum-name) matching JPA's default enum-storage - fine because the entity annotates direction with @Enumerated(EnumType.STRING) (confirmed in EbmsMessageEntity). Sound.

Fix #2 (OrchestratorService.buildRetryHeader): reconstructs all critical header fields including nested PartyId(type/value)/ServiceType(type/value)/MessageInfo(messageId/timestamp/refToMessageId). AckRequested is correctly mapped as null when entity.ackRequested=false (verified in retry_ackRequestedFalse_leavesAckNull). One minor code-review note: buildRetryHeader() does NOT restore requireSigning / requireEncryption on the EbmsOutboundMessage - if a downstream OutboundMessageService branches on those booleans they will default to false on retry. Not necessarily a bug (they may be re-derived from CPA), but worth confirming with the OutboundMessageService owner.

Fix #3 (MessageStatusReconciliationScheduler): clean split into private reconcileDirection(direction, timeoutMinutes) called twice; INBOUND uses a distinct property `ebms.watchdog.inbound-stuck-processing-timeout-minutes` (default 30) and produces an errorMessage clearly identifying the missing downstream consumer. Both branches are covered by the rewritten unit test.

OrchestratorService now has 6 collaborators + 2 @Value fields - still acceptable but the retry orchestration is now a meaningful subresponsibility. If retry logic grows further (e.g. exponential backoff, dead-letter routing) consider extracting a MessageRetryService.

Consumer gap confirmed: `grep -R "@RabbitListener" /app/ebms-adapter | grep -i inbound` shows NO listener currently consumes `ebms.inbound.messages`. That's the exact root cause behind the need for the longer INBOUND watchdog threshold - correct mitigation, but the missing consumer itself is still a real product gap and should be tracked as a separate work item (out of scope for this iteration).
MessageStatusReconciliationScheduler.reconcileDirection() computes threshold from timeoutMinutes * 60L seconds - correct arithmetic (long multiplication avoids int-overflow for large minute values).

Test class `OrchestratorServiceRetryHeaderTest` uses @InjectMocks + a `new RetryProperties()` set via ReflectionTestUtils because RetryProperties is a @ConfigurationProperties POJO with defaults - avoids mocking a value object (correct pattern).

Minor: EbmsMessageEntity.ackRequested is a primitive boolean with @Builder.Default = false; buildRetryHeader treats it as tri-state (true -> AckRequested{}, else null). No third state possible, so this is deterministic - fine.

rca of the issue: Pre-fix loop: (a) INBOUND messages left in PROCESSING by the absent ebms.inbound.messages consumer were flipped to FAILED by the watchdog; (b) findMessagesForRetry() lacked a direction filter, so those INBOUND FAILED rows re-emerged as retry candidates for OrchestratorService.retryFailedMessages(); (c) even for legit OUTBOUND retries the built EbmsOutboundMessage had header=null (only messageId+scheduledAt), so OutboundMessageService rejected with 'ontbrekende header' without persisting a terminal status - allowing the watchdog to re-catch the row every ~10min. Mitigation validated by tests: (1) repository query now hard-filters direction='OUTBOUND'; (2) buildRetryHeader reconstructs a full EbxmlMessageHeader from persisted columns (verified via ArgumentCaptor on rabbitTemplate.convertAndSend); (3) INBOUND now uses a separate 30-min threshold with a downstream-consumer hint in errorMessage.
